_comment: Income reading rules. None of this is in the AECB payload -- employment
rows carry a bare GrossAnnualIncome with no currency, no monthly/annual
flag and no quality marker, so the three judgements below are policy and
live here rather than as literals in the renderer.
_currency_comment: Assumed. The payload carries no currency field; every figure is rendered in this unit and the section says so.
_placeholder_floor_comment: A GrossAnnualIncome above zero but below this is a provider placeholder, not an income -- the reference payload carries 1 on two rows. Such a figure is still shown, flagged, but is kept out of the chart scale where it would flatten every real point onto the axis. Exactly zero is NOT a placeholder: a reported zero is a delivered fact and is plotted.
